## 1. NARRATIVE ARC

Across six consecutive calls the core story does not shift — it **compounds**. That is itself the signal: a company whose narrative is stable, specific, and serially over-delivered is rare. The arc widens in three deliberate ways.

**(a) From "Wencor integration" to "firing on all engines."** In FQ2'25 (2025-05-28) the marginal story is still the Wencor combination — *"the Wencor and Legacy HEICO operations continue to exceed our expectations… this was an excellent combination"* — and the proof point is 14% organic FSG growth on top of deals.
